response:
FADE IN:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

We see a bustling medieval kingdom, with knights in shining armor, merchants hawking their wares, and peasants scurrying about. But amidst the chaos, we notice something strange. The king, a stout and regal figure with a thick beard, is pacing back and forth in front of a large, ornate mirror.

KING (he) addresses his trusted advisor, a bespectacled wizard named ZORVATH (he).

KING
(to Zorvath)
I have a vision, my friend. A vision of a new era for our empire. An era of... of... (he searches for the right words)...of futurism.

ZORVATH
(skeptical)
Futurism, Your Majesty? But we are in the Middle Ages.

KING
(nodding)
Exactly. We must break free from the shackles of tradition. We must... (he gestures grandly)...we must vaporwave our aesthetic.

ZORVATH
(confused)
Vaporwave, Your Majesty? But that's a... a... (he searches for the right words)...a genre of music.

KING
(determined)
Yes, yes, yes. Music. But also... (he snaps his fingers)...also fashion. Also... (he thinks for a moment)...also architecture.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king, resplendent in a shimmering silver jumpsuit, sits on his throne, surrounded by his courtiers. They are all dressed in the latest vaporwave fashion, with neon-colored wigs, oversized sunglasses, and plenty of pastel-colored clothing.

KING
(to his courtiers)
We must... (he gestures to a nearby servant)...we must add more... (he searches for the right words)...more synths to our architecture.

SERVANT
(nervously)
Yes, Your Majesty. I'll see to it immediately.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is now transformed. The buildings are adorned with neon lights, the streets are paved with a glittering, iridescent material, and the people are all dressed in the latest vaporwave fashion.

KING
(to Zorvath)
See? I told you it would work.

ZORVATH
(surprised)
It's... it's quite something, Your Majesty.

KING
(smiling)
Yes, yes, yes. We are the pioneers of a new era. An era of... (he searches for the right words)...of retro-futurism.

CUT TO:

INT. KING'S THRONE ROOM - DAY

The king, surrounded by his courtiers, is now wearing a pair of oversized, mirrored sunglasses.

KING
(to his courtiers)
We must... (he gestures to a nearby servant)...we must add more... (he searches for the right words)...more distortion to our music.

SERVANT
(nervously)
Yes, Your Majesty. I'll see to it immediately.

CUT TO:

EXT. MEDIEVAL KINGDOM - DAY

The kingdom is now a surreal, dreamlike landscape. The buildings are melting, the streets are filled with fog, and the people are all dressed in the latest vaporwave fashion.

KING
(to Zorvath)
See? I told you it would work.

ZORVATH
(surprised)
It's... it's quite something, Your Majesty.

KING
(smiling)
Yes, yes, yes. We are the pioneers of a new era. An era of... (he searches for the right words)...of psychedelic futurism.

FADE TO BLACK.
